_comment: Verified CC0 / no-attribution-required audio tracks for long-form (ambient/phonk) and short-form (swap-in for reused clips). Agent 4.2 and Agent 3.1 only pull from entries where verified=true. verification_note must state what was checked (license tag AND source page), not just the platform label.

tracks.title: Phonk ish
tracks.verification_note: Checked the license badge/link on the track's own FMA page (not a third-party aggregator claim): rel="license" anchor points directly to https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/. Also confirmed via the site's own download-overlay modal (https://freemusicarchive.org/track/phonk-ish/downloadOverlay/) which explicitly states 'CC0/Public Domain' for this track. Direct file download via the standard /track/<slug>/download/ route requires an FMA login (302 to /login when unauthenticated), so the file was instead fetched from the same-page embedded data-track-info JSON's public 'fileUrl' field, which points to FMA's own CDN (files.freemusicarchive.org) and required no authentication. Downloaded file verified via `file` and `ffprobe`: real MPEG audio, 320kbps, 48kHz stereo, 145.56s duration, non-corrupt, non-zero size (5,823,523 bytes). Stylistic match note: FMA has no literal 'phonk' genre-CC0 catalog beyond this artist; HoliznaCC0 is a netlabel-style artist who explicitly self-releases all work as CC0 and this track is genre-tagged/titled 'Phonk ish' under album 'PHONK - AURA FARMING', a genuine bass-driven electronic instrumental — closest real CC0 match found to the requested slowed hardtekk/phonk direction (no lyrics, no recognizable sample).
